author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Patlabor: The Case Files trailer for this upcoming 3D action game that lets players experience many of the most memorable moments from the beloved Mobile Police Patlabor series. The new trailer showcases the three main modes, including Main Mission, Another Side Mission, and Simulator Mode.

Labors are giant robots originally developed for industrial use. As their adoption across construction and civil engineering rapidly expanded, Labor-related crime also became increasingly common. In response, the Tokyo Metropolitan Police established the Special Vehicles Section 2 Patrol Labor Unit to combat this new threat. Thus, the Patlabor was born.
title: Patlabor: The Case Files - Official Third Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Seaworks: Trap Season announcement trailer for this upcoming crab fishing life simulation set among the cold waters and isolated islands of the Pacific Northwest during the 1990s. Seaworks: Trap Season will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in 2026.

Starting with little more than a small boat and a fax machine to print orders, you must learn how to make the most of every trip at sea. Whether on a calm day, or for an urgent order whilst battling waves, you head out to the sea, place crab traps beneath the water and return later to haul them aboard, hoping to have secured enough catch to earn a day’s wages. Each catch must be sorted by hand, discarding sick crabs, trash and other unplanned loot, before the crabs can be sold fresh or processed for better returns.
title: Seaworks: Trap Season - Official Announcement Trailer

description:
Take a look at the Rideshare "Stimulator" announcement trailer for this upcoming driving sim that puts you behind the wheel of your own bustling rideshare business. Rideshare "Stimulator" will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2026.

Welcome to Ottoberg. Would you like us to pick you up? There is currently a driver nearby. 

Dodge traffic and race the clock to get your riders where they need to go. Follow the rules of the road, master your vehicle, and keep your passengers happy to earn good ratings, grow your rideshare business, and upgrade your rides. Don’t get distracted with whatever is happening in the back seat! You never know what stories you’ll hear, from the hilarious to captivating to just plain weird.
title: Rideshare "Stimulator" - Official Announcement Trailer

Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

description:
Here's your look at the Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos announcement trailer for this upcoming remaster of the classic sequel to Croc: Legend of the Gobbos. Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos will feature enhanced visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and over 40 levels of expanded 3D platforming, including new traversal mechanics like triple jumping, vehicles, and aerial gameplay. The remaster will also introduce the 'Croc2pedia,' an in-game digital museum featuring never-before-seen development materials, cut content, and developer interviews. 

In Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos, Croc sets off for the mainland in search of his long-lost parents. However, his journey becomes a showdown as his arch-nemesis, Baron Dante, is resurrected by the Dantinis and vows revenge. Croc's quest takes him through four distinct villages, where he rescues captured Gobbos and faces off against a roster of Guardians, including Soveena the Squid, whose obsession with Ginger Soda makes her a menace to contend wi
title: Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos - Official Announcement Trailer

Rules of Engagement: The Grey State is an upcoming co-op horror extraction shooter that has two separate game modes: co-op PvE and squad-based PvP. This trailer reveals the PvE side of the game.
